newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market closes higher, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market closes higher, seen rising.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market inched up on Monday as investors showed growing interest in oil refineries, traders said.
They said they expected a recovery on Tuesday, with most high-cap prices starting to edge up in slightly stronger buying mood.

Unofficial indices VAB-RA, computed by VANGUARD securities, and BIG-OTC, compiled by BIG brokerage house, rose by 2.7 and respectively 4.42 percent from the previous session to 3,389.3 and 2,441.04 points.
Oil refineries were in investor focus on Monday, with Arpechim and Petrobrazi at the forefront. Arpechim closed 5,500 lei firmer at 25,000 and Petromidia gained 500 lei to 16,500.
Traders expected oil companies to start on an upward trend in the coming days due to a relatively strong buying pressure.
Cement makers stayed relatively stable on Monday, with Romcim closing 1,000 lei up at 67,000 and Romcif ending a scant 15 lei down at 1,800.
Operators did not expect major price movements in cement stocks throughout the week, saying investor interest in this sector was staying constant.
Overall, 112 shares rose, 93 fell and 309 remained flat from Friday's close. Turnover climbed to 6.99 billion lei from 5.31 on Friday, with 2.25 million shares changing hands.
